double_ma.name: 双均线策略
double_ma.description: 基于短期和长期均线的金叉/死叉信号。当快线上穿慢线时买入，下穿时卖出。适合趋势行情。
double_ma.code:
"""双均线策略 — 金叉买入，死叉卖出."""
from eqlib import *


def initialize(context):
    """Strategy initialization."""
    g.security = "601390"
    g.fast_period = 5
    g.slow_period = 20

    set_benchmark("000300.XSHG")
    set_order_cost(OrderCost(
        open_tax=0,
        close_tax=0.0005,
        open_commission=0.00025,
        close_commission=0.00025,
        close_today_commission=0,
        min_commission=5,
    ))

    context.universe = [g.security]
    run_daily(market_open, time="every_bar")

    log.info("双均线策略初始化: %s" % g.security)


def market_open(context):
    """每日交易逻辑：均线金叉买入，死叉卖出."""
    security = g.security
    close_data = attribute_history(security, 25, "1d", ["close"])

    if close_data.empty or len(close_data) < g.slow_period:
        return

    fast_ma = close_data["close"].tail(g.fast_period).mean()
    slow_ma = close_data["close"].tail(g.slow_period).mean()
    current_price = close_data["close"].iloc[-1]

    prev_fast = close_data["close"].tail(g.fast_period + 1).head(g.fast_period).mean()
    prev_slow = close_data["close"].tail(g.slow_period + 1).head(g.slow_period).mean()

    cash = context.portfolio.available_cash

    # 金叉买入
    if prev_fast <= prev_slow and fast_ma > slow_ma:
        if security not in context.portfolio.positions or context.portfolio.positions[security].amount == 0:
            order_value(security, cash)
            log.info("Golden cross BUY: %s @ %.3f" % (security, current_price))

    # 死叉卖出
    elif prev_fast >= prev_slow and fast_ma < slow_ma:
        if security in context.portfolio.positions and context.portfolio.positions[security].amount > 0:
            order_target(security, 0)
            log.info("Death cross SELL: %s @ %.3f" % (security, current_price))

    record(price=current_price, fast_ma=fast_ma, slow_ma=slow_ma)

momentum.name: 动量策略
momentum.description: 基于过去N日涨幅的动量因子策略。当涨幅超过阈值时加仓，低于阈值时清仓。适合趋势延续行情。
momentum.code:
"""动量策略 — 追涨杀跌，顺势而为."""
from eqlib import *


def initialize(context):
    """Strategy initialization."""
    g.security = "000001"
    g.lookback = 20
    g.buy_threshold = 0.05
    g.sell_threshold = -0.03

    set_benchmark("000300.XSHG")
    set_order_cost(OrderCost(
        open_tax=0,
        close_tax=0.0005,
        open_commission=0.00025,
        close_commission=0.00025,
        close_today_commission=0,
        min_commission=5,
    ))

    context.universe = [g.security]
    run_daily(market_open, time="every_bar")


def market_open(context):
    """基于动量信号交易."""
    security = g.security
    close_data = attribute_history(security, g.lookback + 1, "1d", ["close"])

    if close_data.empty or len(close_data) < g.lookback + 1:
        return

    first_close = close_data["close"].iloc[0]
    last_close = close_data["close"].iloc[-1]
    momentum = (last_close - first_close) / first_close

    cash = context.portfolio.available_cash
    pos = context.portfolio.positions.get(security)

    if momentum > g.buy_threshold:
        if pos is None or pos.amount == 0:
            order_value(security, cash * 0.3)
            log.info("Momentum BUY: %s momentum=%.4f" % (security, momentum))
    elif momentum < g.sell_threshold:
        if pos and pos.amount > 0:
            order_target(security, 0)
            log.info("Momentum SELL: %s momentum=%.4f" % (security, momentum))

    record(momentum=momentum, price=last_close)

mean_reversion.name: 均值回归策略
mean_reversion.description: 基于布林带的均值回归策略。当价格跌破下轨时买入（超卖），突破上轨时卖出（超买）。适合震荡行情。
mean_reversion.code:
"""均值回归策略 — 布林带上下轨交易."""
from eqlib import *
import numpy as np


def initialize(context):
    """Strategy initialization."""
    g.security = "600519"
    g.period = 20
    g.num_std = 2.0

    set_benchmark("000300.XSHG")
    set_order_cost(OrderCost(
        open_tax=0,
        close_tax=0.0005,
        open_commission=0.00025,
        close_commission=0.00025,
        close_today_commission=0,
        min_commission=5,
    ))

    context.universe = [g.security]
    run_daily(market_open, time="every_bar")


def market_open(context):
    """布林带均值回归逻辑."""
    security = g.security
    close_data = attribute_history(security, g.period + 5, "1d", ["close"])

    if close_data.empty or len(close_data) < g.period:
        return

    closes = close_data["close"].values
    ma = np.mean(closes[-g.period:])
    std = np.std(closes[-g.period:])

    upper_band = ma + g.num_std * std
    lower_band = ma - g.num_std * std
    current_price = closes[-1]

    pos = context.portfolio.positions.get(security)
    cash = context.portfolio.available_cash

    # 价格跌破下轨 → 超卖买入
    if current_price < lower_band:
        if pos is None or pos.amount == 0:
            order_value(security, cash * 0.5)
            log.info("Mean Reversion BUY: %s @ %.3f (lower_band=%.3f)" % (security, current_price, lower_band))

    # 价格突破上轨 → 超买卖出
    elif current_price > upper_band:
        if pos and pos.amount > 0:
            order_target(security, 0)
            log.info("Mean Reversion SELL: %s @ %.3f (upper_band=%.3f)" % (security, current_price, upper_band))

    record(price=current_price, ma=ma, upper=upper_band, lower=lower_band)

turtle_breakout.name: 海龟突破策略
turtle_breakout.description: 经典海龟交易法的简化版。价格突破N日高点时买入，跌破M日低点时卖出。适合突破行情。
turtle_breakout.code:
"""海龟突破策略 — 经典趋势跟踪."""
from eqlib import *


def initialize(context):
    """Strategy initialization."""
    g.security = "000300.XSHG"
    g.entry_period = 20
    g.exit_period = 10

    set_benchmark("000300.XSHG")
    set_order_cost(OrderCost(
        open_tax=0,
        close_tax=0.0005,
        open_commission=0.00025,
        close_commission=0.00025,
        close_today_commission=0,
        min_commission=5,
    ))

    context.universe = [g.security]
    run_daily(market_open, time="every_bar")


def market_open(context):
    """海龟突破逻辑."""
    security = g.security
    high_data = attribute_history(security, g.entry_period + 1, "1d", ["high", "low"])

    if high_data.empty or len(high_data) < g.entry_period:
        return

    # Entry: 突破过去N日最高价
    entry_high = high_data["high"].iloc[:-1].tail(g.entry_period).max()
    # Exit: 跌破过去M日最低价
    exit_low = high_data["low"].iloc[:-1].tail(g.exit_period).min()

    current_price = high_data["high"].iloc[-1]
    pos = context.portfolio.positions.get(security)
    cash = context.portfolio.available_cash

    if current_price > entry_high:
        if pos is None or pos.amount == 0:
            order_value(security, cash * 0.5)
            log.info("Turtle BREAKOUT: %s @ %.3f > high=%.3f" % (security, current_price, entry_high))
    elif current_price < exit_low:
        if pos and pos.amount > 0:
            order_target(security, 0)
            log.info("Turtle BREAKDOWN: %s @ %.3f < low=%.3f" % (security, current_price, exit_low))

    record(price=current_price, entry_high=entry_high, exit_low=exit_low)
